events.info: Welcome to the wonderful Land of Oz... Where there is a young woman, born with emerald-green skin - smart, fiery, misunderstood and possessing an extraordinary talent. When she meets a bubbly blonde who is exceptionally popular, their initial rivalry turns into the unlikeliest of friendships...until the world decides to call one good and the other one wicked. With a thrilling score that includes the hits "Defying Gravity," "Popular" and "For Good," WICKED has been called "A magical Broadway musical with brains, heart and courage" (Time Magazine).
events.pleaseNote: Not recommended for children 8 and under. Children under the age of 6 are not allowed at this DPAC event and all guests require a ticket, regardless of age. Parental discretion is advised

ticketLimit.info: There is an overall 9 ticket limit for this event. To purchase 10 or more tickets, please email us at Groups@DPACnc.com or call 919-281-0587.

venues.name: DPAC

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: In Person: Monday to Saturday: 10am to 2pm Over the Phone: Monday to Friday: 10am to 5pm Saturday: 10am to 2pm Show Days (including Sunday show days): Open starting 3 hours before show time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Location: The Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina Ticket Center at DPAC Hours: Open 3 hours prior to each performance

venues.parkingDetail: More Than 3,000 Parking Spaces Just Minutes From Our Doors. Convenient parking is easy with three parking decks surrounding DPAC. In total there are more than 3,000 spaces within .10 to .25 mile walking distance from the theater. For guests with mobility impairments or guests uncomfortable walking from our nearby parking areas, DPAC has a Courtesy Shuttle from the American Tobacco North Deck. Guests who wish to use the North Deck Courtesy Shuttle should request accessible parking on the ground floor from the parking attendant in the North Deck. Once parked, look for the shuttle pick-up signs and benches. DPACs Most Popular Parking Options 1. American Tobacco North Deck , 305 West Pettigrew, Durham, NC 27701 2. 555 Mangum Street, 555 South Mangum Street, Durham, NC 27701 3. American Tobacco East Deck, 250 South Mangum Street, Durham, NC 27701

generalInfo.generalRule: • At DPAC, each event that we host determines their own policy on photography and video recording using mobile phones. • Please note that GoPros, tablets, and cameras of any kind are prohibited at all DPAC events. • For more information, visit https://www.dpacnc.com/events
generalInfo.childRule: All guests require a ticket, regardless of age. Children under the age of 6 are not allowed at most DPAC performances including Broadway, Concerts and Comedy shows. Children must be able to sit quietly in their own seat without disturbing other guests. Some shows make further age appropriate recommendations, and DPAC will provide those on its website; however, parental discretion is always advised, and judgment of the content for each show should be made on an individual basis prior to purchase. This policy does not include special kids shows such as Disney Live, Wild Kratts and Peppa Pig.

ada.adaCustomCopy:
DPAC offers wheelchair accessible seating throughout all seating levels allowing for a choice in view and ticket prices. In addition there are also seating options for guests with visual, hearing and mobility impairments. Bariatric seating and seating for persons of size are also available.  Accessible seats are available online and in person or by phone at The Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina Ticket Center at DPAC. For related questions, please email us at customerservice@dpacnc.com.

For more information on accessibility options, please visit www.dpacnc.com/plan-your-visit/accessibility
ada.adaHours: The Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina Ticket Center at DPAC is open in person Monday-Friday 10am-2pm, and by phone Monday-Friday 10am-5pm and Saturday 10am-2pm, and three hours prior to each performance.   The Ticket Center is located on the northeast corner of DPAC on the corner of Vivian St and Mangum St.

venues.name: Carolina Theatre - Durham

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: In Advance : Weekdays 11:00am - 6:00pm Day of Event : One hour prior to showtime
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Location : Main Box Office is to the right of main theatre entrance, facing plaza. Opens : One hour before the event Please bring picture I.D.,the actual credit card used when purchasing the tickets,and confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: Location : Street parking along Morgan St. or nearby; Durham Centre garage directly across Morgan St. from the theatre; additional decks nearby at 326 East Chapel Hill Street, directly in front of the post office, and at the 101 East Corcoran Street. Specific location for Accessible Parking : Two spaces on Morgan St. along plaza in front of theatre; additional accessible parking available across the street in Durham Centre garage. Charge for Parking (per vehicle) : Free (on street, after 6 pm or on weekends) or $3 per vehicle (in Durham Centre garage, after 6 pm or on weekends).

generalInfo.generalRule: Items NOT allowed : Cameras (still or video) and sound recording devices, unless authorized by the artist/promoter for a specific event; outside food or drink; firearms Smoking is NOT permitted anywhere in the building, but ashtrays are available on the plaza in front of the theatre.
generalInfo.childRule: Age limit to enter : None, unless specified for event. Children under 2 admitted free for "lap seating" ONLY unless otherwise specified for event. ALL OTHERS must have a ticket.
